scenarios.title: Direct QR scan displays note form before submission
given: the user initiates a direct QR scan
then: a note form is displayed before submission occurs
a clear option to submit without a note is visible to the user

scenarios.title: Submit direct QR scan with a note
given: the user has scanned a direct QR code
the note form is currently displayed
scenarios.when: the user enters note text (e.g. 'Priority delivery') and submits
then: the scan submission completes successfully with the note included

scenarios.title: Submit direct QR scan without a note
given: the user has scanned a direct QR code
the note form is currently displayed
scenarios.when: the user chooses the option to submit without a note
then: the scan submission proceeds without requiring note input
the scan submission completes successfully with no note attached

scenarios.title: Vendor code is displayed when vendor was preselected via cookie
given: a vendor has already been selected via cookie (e.g. vendor code 'VND123')
scenarios.when: the user performs a direct QR scan
then: the preselected vendor code is visibly displayed within the scan flow

scenarios.title: Vendor code is omitted when no vendor is selected via cookie
given: no vendor has been selected via cookie
scenarios.when: the user performs a direct QR scan
then: no vendor code is displayed in the scan flow
